author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am pushing for the shadow environment to have a formal sign-off process before any model is promoted. I want the governance to be strict and complete, with documented evidence that the new forecast matches the live baseline within acceptable error margins. I see this as a driver for reliability. The more rigorous the review, the better we protect the integrity of the live system. I am not asking for a single check, but a continuous, automated validation loop that flags any deviation. I want the team to treat this as a core requirement, not an optional step. The goal is to ensure that when we do switch over, the new model is proven, not just assumed. I am advocating for a higher standard of verification to build long term confidence in the platform.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly identifies the rigorous sign-off process as a driver for reliability and advocates for a higher standard of verification to build long-term confidence, indicating that doing more than a basic check would make them happier.
